release_notes: Added application language support for Japanese, German and Swedish.
Improved language selection so Morsewurst can restart automatically after the application language is changed.
Added adjustable character mix ratios for letters, numbers and punctuation.
Improved multilingual UI behaviour across the settings window and language restart messages.
Improved skill level panel structure and display reliability across different UI languages.
Fixed and refined several UI, settings and layout issues.
General bug fixes, stability improvements and user experience refinements.
